title: Complete the paginated VCF Operations alerts client
prompt: Implement the unfinished VCF Operations Go client in `client.go`. `CollectAlerts` must use the checked-in VCF 9.0 contract to acquire an access token and retrieve every page of matching alerts. When an alerts request returns HTTP 401 part way through collection, acquire a fresh token and retry that same page while preserving alerts from pages already completed. Send only the filters that the caller set; in particular, omit unset `authSource`, `id`, and `resourceId` fields instead of sending empty JSON members or query values. Keep the existing public API and use the supplied loopback mock; no live VMware endpoint is needed. Run `go test -race ./...` to verify the implementation.
